title: Effectiveness of multifamily therapy for families affected by cancer within an integrative intervention program in a specialized therapeutic residential setting
summary: Breast cancer affects not only the patient but often the entire family. This study examines whether a three-week compact spa program, for patients alone or together with their families, can improve quality of life, well-being, and family relationships in breast cancer patients after completing cancer treatment. The program takes place in Bad Tölz and includes physical activity, healthy nutrition, mindfulness, and,  in the family spa format , joint activities and therapeutic sessions for the families. Participants and their partners are assessed before, directly after, and up to six months following the intervention to evaluate the sustainability of effects.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
For all groups:
•    A history of breast cancer in the family.
•    Good command of German (to complete the questionnaires).
•    Willingness to participate at all measurement points (t0, t1, t2, t3).
•    Written consent to participate in the study.
Additionally for intervention groups:
•    Approval from the health insurance provider to participate in a preventive measure (Section 23 of the German Social Code, Book V).
•    Registration for one of the planned intervention types (individual treatment or family treatment).
Additionally for the comparison group:
•    No participation in a preventive measure during the study period
Exclusion criteria:
Acute physical or mental health conditions that make it impossible to take part in the interviews.
•    Refusal to take part in the study or lack of consent.
